# Upstream licences and notices

These unchanged texts accompany the resolved Desktop/Local API package union.
The union includes native packages for other RIDs; presence here does not imply
that every listed binary is in a particular archive. Hermaeus remains licensed
under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Each upstream component retains its own terms.

The table records source and SHA256 for the exact bytes delivered. NuGet entries
were compared with their corresponding members in the existing original nupkg.
Other entries came from the repository commit recorded in that package's nuspec.
The Inter font identifies version 3.019 and git-0a5106e0b in its name table; its
regular font bytes match the resource in Avalonia.Fonts.Inter 12.1.3. The matching
Inter licence is included separately from the Avalonia package licence.

This is delivery/provenance evidence, not legal clearance or a claim that all
embedded native attribution has been exhaustively identified. Native SQLite
package terms and unresolved artwork/asset provenance remain release gates.

SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 3.50.3 contains no licence element or standalone licence
text in its nuspec/nupkg. Its recorded source commit has no repository URL, and
that commit was not found in SQLitePCL.raw. The Apache licence below applies to
the separately identified 3.0.0 wrappers. SQLite's own public-domain statement
does not resolve all provenance or distribution terms of this native package.
The native package remains pinned and unchanged pending clarification.
Its version-specific [unresolved gate](SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3/3.50.3/README.md)
is delivered alongside the available legal texts. Original upstream punctuation
and line endings are retained; Git attributes prevent text conversion.
